## Work in progress

::: {.paper}
::: {.paper-title}
The Welfare Gains from Income-Targeting Green Subsidies
:::
::: {.coauthors}
with Joep Keuzenkamp
:::
::: {.abstract}
We evaluate the Dutch ISDE heat pump subsidy and decompose its Marginal Value of
Public Funds into a transfer component and an abatement component, asking what
income-targeting the subsidy schedule would be worth.
:::
:::

::: {.paper}
::: {.paper-title}
Relieving Credit Constraints in the Energy Transition: Adoption, Policy Interactions, and Welfare
:::
::: {.coauthors}
with Inge van den Bijgaart and L. Sileci
:::
::: {.abstract}
We study the Dutch zero-interest green loan scheme using CBS administrative
microdata, separating the decision to borrow from the decision to adopt, and
ask how the loan interacts with the heat pump subsidy that runs alongside it.
:::
:::
